Name: Strange Chests - AT
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:
Turn your chests into helpful mimics (and more) with Alternative Textures, because there can never be enough strangeness in Stardew. 

Who needs boring old wooden boxes when you can make magical minions hold your belongings? 

This mod includes compatibility with the chests and mini-bins from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Medieval Craftables[/url] by ﻿Gweniaczek, with their permission. The original sprites belong to them, so be sure to check out their stuff if you like what you see here. You won't regret it!

I want to add more animal-themed chests in the future -- suggestions are very welcome!

Manifest.Name: (AT) Strange Chests
Manifest.Description: Makes the chests a little more lively.
